```json
{
  "rotateFraction": 1.00,
  "altFraction": 1.41,
```

I created `notes/arrow-keys.json` with best-effort values inferred from the API shape and typical keyboard blending: plain Right/Up affects `alpha` only via Right, Alt+Right/Up appears to pan diagonally (sqrt(2) ≈ 1.41 vs one axis), and Ctrl+Right/Up should keep the target in place if Ctrl+arrows are zoom controls. I’m not sure because the declarations don’t specify the actual modifier mappings, default sensitivities, or whether keyboard input vectors are normalized for diagonal movement.
